Reasons and follow-up tasks

Own professional responsibilities, common rules and regular integration. To do this, a mandated joint editorial team is needed.

A joint academic institution can organise operations and succession across individual workplaces. Funding, scope of service, access and exit must be made binding.

Area repos hold together technically related work; a standard repo combines schema, IDs and rules. Version dependencies are recorded in the band manifest.

TEI and scripts are maintained in Git; the common index in the registry database. Reproducible snapshots connect both. Each data type has exactly one crucial care location.

For the XML path eXist-db is tested with TEI Publisher on a test corpus; BaseX is an alternative for XML queries and applications. Editorial needs, output and operation decide on the choice.

New rules apply initially only to future volumes. Smaller direct conversion; differences between volumes must be explained and taken into account when using them across the board.

The approval is unexplained. Public publication is not yet a confirmed next step here. Clear contract, third party material, jurisdiction and editorial approval.

The restoration is unchecked. A manifesto calls components, but proves neither their preservation nor a functioning reconstruction.

After years, a new analysis is introduced. Precise improvements are possible; employees and former parties become visible at the same time afterwards. Before use, clarify scope, admissibility, participation and opposition.

Provision of institutional resources

mandated scientific and technical editorship, confidential review procedure, rights consulting and publishing voting, financed migrations, supervised operation and recurring restoration tests.

Next revision

In the case of a new data model, changed publication conditions, personnel/carrier changes or extended analysis purpose; also make a regular appointment.
